description: Hacker News and Bluesky opinion split, NOT a poll: how public posts divide on a question. GET q; optional sides (2-4, default yes,no), window (1-30d). Returns JSON: per-side share with 95% interval and n, counts per source, links only (no text or usernames; Bluesky links include the account's public ID, DID), caveats. Refuses elections, health and a named person's conduct. Under 30 decided posts, refusals and errors: not charged on Base (other rails may charge). Price $0.03 per call via x402, USDC on Base (MCP payments are Base only). Paid calls are subject to Horizon Pulse buyer terms: https://horizonpulse.dev/terms/buyer

q.description: Question or topic, 3-200 chars. Elections/candidates, health and a named person's conduct are refused (Base: not charged; other rails may charge)
